title: Entity Move To Block Behavior
description: Allows mob to move towards a block.

goal_radius.title: Goal Radius
goal_radius.description: Distance in blocks within the mob considers it has reached the goal. This is the "wiggle room" to stop the AI from bouncing back and forth trying to reach a specific spot.

on_reach.title: Reach
on_reach.description: Event to run on block reached.

on_stay_completed.title: Stay Completed
on_stay_completed.description: Event to run on completing a stay of stay_duration at the block.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

search_height.title: Search Height
search_height.description: The height in blocks that the mob will look for the block.

search_range.title: Search Range
search_range.description: The distance in blocks that the mob will look for the block.

speed_multiplier.title: Speed Multiplier
speed_multiplier.description: Movement speed multiplier of the mob when using this AI Goal.

start_chance.title: Start Chance
start_chance.description: Chance to start the behavior (applied after each random tick_interval).

stay_duration.title: Stay Duration
stay_duration.description: Number of ticks needed to complete a stay at the block.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject of this filter test.

test.title: Test
test.description: The name of the test to apply.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value being compared with the test.

target_block_filters.description: Conditions that need to be met for a block to be a valid target.

defaultSnippets.label: Target Offset (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Target Offset as an object

target_offset.title: Target Offset
target_offset.description: Offset to add to the selected target position.

defaultSnippets.label: Target Offset (object)
defaultSnippets.description: Use Target Offset as an object

target_selection_method.title: Target Selection Method
target_selection_method.description: Kind of block to find fitting the specification. Valid values are "random" and "nearest".

tick_interval.title: Tick Interval
tick_interval.description: Average interval in ticks to try to run this behavior.
